results.name: Finset.min'
results.source_text:
/-- Given a nonempty finset `s` in a linear order `α`, then `s.min' H` is its minimum, as an
element of `α`, where `H` is a proof of nonemptiness. Without this assumption, use instead `s.min`,
taking values in `WithTop α`. -/
def min' (s : Finset α) (H : s.Nonempty) : α :=
  inf' s H id
results.docstring:

element of `α`, where `H` is a proof of nonemptiness. Without this assumption, use instead `s.min`,
taking values in `WithTop α`.

results.name: Finset.mem_attachFin

@[simp]
theorem mem_attachFin {s : Finset ℕ} (h : ∀ m ∈ s, m < n) {a : Fin n} :
    a ∈ s.attachFin h ↔ (a : ℕ) ∈ s :=
  ⟨fun h ↦
    let ⟨_, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := Multiset.mem_pmap.1 h
    hb₂ ▸ hb₁,
    fun h ↦ Multiset.mem_pmap.2 ⟨a, h, Fin.eta _ _⟩⟩

results.source_text:
/-- `IsLowerBound T z c` is the property that `c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖` for all `x : T.domain`. -/
def IsLowerBound (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (z : ℂ) (c : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ x : T.domain, c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖
results.docstring: `IsLowerBound T z c` is the property that `c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖` for all `x : T.domain`.

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_of_left_le
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_of_left_le
    {T₁ T₂ : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (hle : T₁ ≤ T₂) {z : ℂ} {c : ℝ} (h : IsLowerBound T₂ z c) :
    IsLowerBound T₁ z c :=
  fun x ↦ @hle.2 x ⟨x, hle.1 x.2⟩ rfl ▸ h ⟨x, hle.1 x.2⟩

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_closure
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_closure
    {T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} {z : ℂ} {c : ℝ} (h : IsLowerBound T z c) : IsLowerBound T.closure z c := by
  by_cases hT : T.IsClosable
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp <|
      hT.graph_closure_eq_closure_graph ▸ T.closure.mem_graph x
    rw [nhds_prod_eq] at hb'
    refine le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' (hb'.fst.norm.const_mul c)
      ((hb'.snd.sub <| hb'.fst.const_smul z).norm) fun n ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := (mem_graph_iff _).mp (hb n)
    exact hy₁ ▸ hy₂ ▸ h y
  · rwa [closure_def' hT]

results.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced_lower_bound
results.source_text:
lemma massTermReduced_lower_bound (P : PotentialParameters) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hk : ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) : P.ξ (Sum.inl 0) - √(∑ a, |P.ξ (Sum.inr a)| ^ 2) ≤ massTermReduced P k := by
  simp only [Fin.isValue, massTermReduced]
  have h1 (a b c : ℝ) (h : - b ≤ c) : a - b ≤ a + c:= by grind
  apply h1
  let ξEuclid : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a => P.ξ (Sum.inr a))
  trans - ‖ξEuclid‖
  · simp [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, ξEuclid]
  trans - (‖k‖ * ‖ξEuclid‖)
  · simp
    simp at hk
    have ha (a b : ℝ) (h : a ≤ 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : a * b ≤ b := by nlinarith
    exact ha _ _ hk (norm_nonneg k) (norm_nonneg ξEuclid)
  trans - ‖⟪k, ξEuclid⟫_ℝ‖
  · simp
    exact abs_real_inner_le_norm k ξEuclid
  trans ⟪k, ξEuclid⟫_ℝ
  · simp
    grind
  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, ξEuclid]

results.name: Finset.Nonempty
results.source_text:
/-- The property `s.Nonempty` expresses the fact that the finset `s` is not empty. It should be used
in theorem assumptions instead of `∃ x, x ∈ s` or `s ≠ ∅` as it gives access to a nice API thanks
to the dot notation. -/
protected def Nonempty (s : Finset α) : Prop := ∃ x : α, x ∈ s
results.docstring:
The property `s.Nonempty` expresses the fact that the finset `s` is not empty. It should be used
in theorem assumptions instead of `∃ x, x ∈ s` or `s ≠ ∅` as it gives access to a nice API thanks
to the dot notation.

results.name: Filter.nonempty_of_mem
results.source_text:
theorem nonempty_of_mem {f : Filter α} [hf : NeBot f] {s : Set α} (hs : s ∈ f) : s.Nonempty :=
  s.eq_empty_or_nonempty.elim (fun h => absurd hs (h.symm ▸ mt empty_mem_iff_bot.mp hf.1)) id

results.name: Filter.NeBot.nonempty_of_mem
results.source_text:
theorem NeBot.nonempty_of_mem {f : Filter α} (hf : NeBot f) {s : Set α} (hs : s ∈ f) : s.Nonempty :=
  @Filter.nonempty_of_mem α f hf s hs

results.name: Filter.nontrivial_iff_nonempty
results.source_text:
theorem nontrivial_iff_nonempty : Nontrivial (Filter α) ↔ Nonempty α :=
  ⟨fun _ =>
    by_contra fun h' =>
      haveI := not_nonempty_iff.1 h'
      not_subsingleton (Filter α) inferInstance,
    @Filter.instNontrivialFilter α⟩

/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
